name: Land of Lincoln 2024

venue.name: Bank of Springfield Center
venue.details: The competition will be held in room B11.

information:
Once  you enter the Main Lobby, you may take the stairs or elevators to the lower level (button is marked LL). B11 is directly across from the elevator.
Per venue rules there is NO FOOD allowed in the venue. Please plan lunch accordingly.
